headline: Journalist shot dead by attackers in Netrokona
summary: Lutfuzzaman Alif Fakir, a district correspondent for Rupashi Bangla TV, was killed by unidentified gunmen in Durgapur Upazila.
details: Lutfuzzaman Alif Fakir, a district correspondent for IP television channel Rupashi Bangla and owner of the Facebook page 'Detective Article', was shot dead by two unidentified attackers in Netrokona.
The attack occurred around 7:30 PM on Thursday in Telunjia village of Birisiri Union, Durgapur Upazila, according to Durgapur Police chief Khondaker Shaker Ahmed.
Witnesses reported that Alif had visited a shop in front of his in-laws' home. After returning to collect a forgotten mobile phone, he was followed by two young men who fired several shots at him.
He was rushed to the Upazila health complex, where doctors declared him dead.
Police recovered spent cartridges from the scene and found bullet marks on the victim's body. The body has been sent for postmortem examination.
caption:
A journalist was shot dead by unidentified gunmen in Netrokona.

Lutfuzzaman Alif Fakir, a district correspondent for IP television channel Rupashi Bangla and owner of the Facebook page 'Detective Article', was shot dead by two unidentified attackers in Netrokona.

The attack occurred around 7:30 PM on Thursday in Telunjia village of Birisiri Union, Durgapur Upazila, according to Durgapur Police chief Khondaker Shaker Ahmed.

Witnesses reported that Alif had visited a shop in front of his in-laws' home. After returning to collect a forgotten mobile phone, he was followed by two young men who fired several shots at him.

He was rushed to the Upazila health complex, where doctors declared him dead.

Police recovered spent cartridges from the scene and found bullet marks on the victim's body. The body has been sent for postmortem examination.

headline: Mob killed Shamim after dragging him from hospital; alleged instigator still free
summary: The victim was reportedly pulled from a medical facility and killed by a crowd, while the person accused of inciting the violence remains at large.
details: A man named Shamim was killed by a mob after being dragged out of a hospital.
The attack occurred after the victim was allegedly targeted by a crowd.
Reports indicate that an individual who instigated the mob violence is still free and has not been apprehended.
The incident highlights concerns over mob justice and the failure to secure patients within medical facilities.
